advisories.title: Several representation regressions are caught only by manual regeneration comparison
advisories.detail: Swapping the host-phase key order (E3), removing the Rust selector doc lines (E7), and (review04 D8) dropping Ts2 selection TS rows all pass the 14 Python groups. Each changes committed generated files, so only reviewer/root byte comparison catches it. The ordering test pins mapping rows only for Ts2 FactBatch. Add an automated golden test comparing Renderer output (bodies and selectorMappings) with committed generated/, or assert all 8 mapping rows and doc lines.

advisories.title: Emitted-type refusal has no dedicated test
advisories.detail: Removing the identical emitted Rust/TS type refusal (E5) passes all tests, because the test uses identical declarations, which the declaration check refuses first. The guard works independently: same ref with an extra key, and the same extern generatedType with a different schemaRef, are refused. Add one differing-declaration/same-emitted-type case.

advisories.title: Alias-equal alternatives are accepted, as disclosed
advisories.detail: ref Ts2DigestHex vs ref Ts2Sha256Text (both String/string) and text enum ['a'] vs const 'a' (same TS literal) render. Selector meaning stays recoverable through the fixed mapping and Rust variant/doc, so this is not a representation defect. TS unions for such pairs cannot distinguish the alternatives, consistent with the disclosure that TS does not carry host selection.
